```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import anndata

ref = sc.read_h5ad("2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad")
query = sc.read_h5ad("3_carpallcohort3_clustered.h5ad")

# Make clean mapping copies
ref_map = anndata.AnnData(
    X=ref.layers["counts"].copy(),
    obs=ref.obs.copy(),
    var=ref.var.copy()
)

query_map = anndata.AnnData(
    X=query.layers["counts"].copy(),
    obs=query.obs.copy(),
    var=query.var.copy()
)

# Save
ref_map.write_h5ad("2.5_car_no_gd_mapping.h5ad")
query_map.write_h5ad("3_carpallcohort3_mapping.h5ad")
```

```{python}
print(ref_map)
print(query_map)

print(ref_map.layers.keys())
print(query_map.layers.keys())
```
